seo.title: About Oraixen: Custom Software for Growing Businesses
seo.description: Oraixen designs and builds mobile apps, web platforms, corporate software, and hardware + AI solutions. From a freelance team in 2019 to Oraixen in 2025: transparent delivery and support past launch.

hero.title: Software built to perform, and grow with your business.
hero.subtitle: We help growing businesses turn operational problems and product ideas into reliable custom software.

story.title: How Oraixen came to be
story.intro: Oraixen works across six service groups: custom business systems, web platforms and e-commerce, mobile applications, AI solutions and automation, hardware and software systems, and system modernization and integrations, for startups, SMBs, and enterprises.
story.history: We started as a freelance team in 2019, working closely with early clients to build clean, dependable products. In 2025 we became Oraixen: the same team, the same standards, now under one name.

p1.before: The name reflects how we work.
p1.after: , from "origin," because we aim to be the starting point of each client's success story.

p2.after: represents the connection between the markets we serve: Egypt, China, Canada, Europe, MENA, and the USA.

p3.after: represents continuity, because our role continues well beyond launch.

story.closing: We build for education, healthcare, e-commerce, finance, services, and technology, with full transparency, realistic timelines, and support that doesn't end at delivery.
story.tagline: Build the future. Build with Oraixen.
